name: Singlife One Clark International Marathon

ai_summary: The Singlife One Clark International Marathon is a full-marathon event organized by RUNRIO Inc., scheduled for September 20, 2026, at the Clark Parade Grounds in Clark Freeport, Pampanga, Philippines.
